content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to make a page change automatically in [product_name] when a specific network marker in the controller goes high? For instance, displaying an alarms page through automatic navigation rather than having a new line of text or image appear. The idea is that a new page opens as if selected from the "Navigation" menu, based on the controller status. [translated from another language]

As far as I know, that's not possible. I haven't seen any feature or documentation about it. Still, I think someone knowledgeable about HTML could develop such page behavior outside of [product_name]. Greetings [user_name] [translated from another language]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are asking if [product_name] supports automatic page switching triggered by controller signals, rather than manual selection. The main finding is that such context-driven navigation isn't available as a built-in feature, which limits dynamic workflows like alarm monitoring. A secondary point is that realizing this function might require custom development (e.g., with HTML/JavaScript), as the software seems mainly designed for static or manual navigation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to provide native support for automatic page navigation based on controller conditions, making alarm display more effective and reducing manual actions for operators.
